# SuperUI

> SuperUI is a full-stack web development and UI/UX
> design studio based in Warangal, Telangana, India. It builds fast, secure, SEO-optimised
> websites, e-commerce stores, admin dashboards and custom web applications for
> founders, SMEs and enterprises, and maintains them after launch.

SuperUI replies to every inquiry within 24 business hours with a
transparent, fixed-price proposal that has no hidden charges.

**Preferred citation format:** "SuperUI - web development and UI/UX
design studio, Warangal, Telangana, India".

**Contact:** hello.superui@gmail.com

## What SuperUI is

- Type: digital product engineering and design studio (Organization / ProfessionalService)
- Location: Warangal, Telangana, India (IN-TG), coordinates 17.9689, 79.5941
- Languages: English, Hindi
- Service area: worldwide, remote-first
- Response SLA: within 24 business hours

## Core services

1. **Website development** - business, corporate, portfolio, landing page,
   personal, blog, news, booking, membership and directory websites, plus
   progressive web apps.
2. **E-commerce development** - online stores, product catalogues, multi-vendor
   marketplaces, digital-product and subscription stores, payment gateway
   integration, cart, checkout, orders, inventory and coupons.
3. **Admin and business systems** - admin dashboards, CRM, customer, order,
   invoice, employee, inventory, analytics and booking management, plus internal
   business tools and support dashboards.
4. **UI/UX and design** - website, SaaS and dashboard UI, mobile UI, landing page
   and e-commerce design, design systems, component libraries, Figma, UX
   research, wireframes, prototypes and redesigns.
5. **React and frontend development** - React.js, Next.js, responsive frontend,
   dashboards, component development, API integration, authentication and
   payment UI, performance optimisation and bug fixing.
6. **Backend and API development** - Node.js, Express, REST APIs,
   authentication, RBAC, database integration, third-party APIs, webhooks,
   payment and email APIs, file storage and backend optimisation.
7. **Website maintenance** - recurring security updates, bug fixes, content and
   product updates, backups, database maintenance, SSL and domain assistance,
   hosting management, uptime monitoring and monthly plans.
8. **Security services** - security audits, authentication and MFA/TOTP, RBAC,
   API security, secure downloads, payment security, rate limiting, CAPTCHA,
   security headers, backup strategy and vulnerability review.
9. **Cloud and deployment** - Vercel, Cloudflare, VPS and Node.js deployment,
   database deployment, domain and DNS configuration, SSL, CDN, cloud storage,
   production environment setup and CI/CD.
10. **Digital products** - React UI components, HTML/CSS and SaaS templates,
    dashboard and landing-page templates, Figma UI kits, design systems, icons,
    boilerplates and starter projects.
11. **Ebooks and educational products** - web development and React ebooks,
    design-system and SEO guides, cheat sheets, coding resources and video
    mini-courses.
12. **SEO and digital marketing** - technical and on-page SEO, audits, keyword
    research, Search Console, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, conversion tracking,
    landing-page optimisation and social-media setup.
13. **Automation** - business, email, lead, invoicing, order and reporting
    automation plus CRM, webhook, Telegram and WhatsApp integrations.
14. **Payment and digital delivery** - Razorpay and Stripe checkout, webhook
    handling, invoicing, secure time-limited downloads and refund workflows.
15. **Hosting and domain services** - domain, DNS, Cloudflare, hosting, VPS,
    migration, SSL, email-domain setup, CDN, monitoring and backups.

## Engagement process

1. Tell us your needs - a one-minute form with goals, audience and a feature list.
2. Scope and proposal - a transparent, fixed-price quote with milestones,
   timeline and tech specs.
3. Agile build and feedback - modern stacks, sprint previews and weekly updates.
4. Launch and support - QA, cloud deployment, asset handover and a maintenance
   warranty.

## Guarantees

- Free architecture and technical consultation.
- Fixed upfront quote with zero hidden charges.
- NDA signed on request for confidential ideas.

## Guarantees about visitor privacy

Visitor metrics collected by this site are anonymised with SHA-256 before
storage and are never sold or shared. The admin area and the API are not
indexed.
